company.name: Chatwoot
company.shortDescription: An open-source omnichannel customer engagement suite
company.description: Chatwoot is an open-source, self-hosted customer engagement suite. Chatwoot lets you view and manage your customer data, communicate with them irrespective of which medium they use, and re-engage them based on their profile.

productsAndServices.description: An AI assistant that automates customer support by learning from help center content, chats, and FAQs to answer common questions and assist agents with smart reply suggestions and translations.
productsAndServices.name: Captain AI Agent

productsAndServices.description: A unified inbox that consolidates customer conversations from websites, email, social media, and messaging platforms into a single interface for streamlined support management.
productsAndServices.name: Omnichannel Support Desk

productsAndServices.description: A customizable knowledge base that provides customers with self-service access to answers and support content, organized by portals and enhanced with AI-powered search.
productsAndServices.name: Knowledge Base (Help Center)

productsAndServices.description: A customizable live chat widget for websites that enables real-time customer engagement with options to tailor design, language, and behavior to match brand identity.
productsAndServices.name: Live Chat Widget

productsAndServices.description: APIs and integration capabilities that allow businesses to extend Chatwoot's functionality and connect with external systems or chatbot platforms.
productsAndServices.name: Developer APIs and Integrations

productsAndServices.description: Features that support internal collaboration among customer support agents, including shared inboxes, private notes, labels, and team management.
productsAndServices.name: Team Collaboration Tools

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $1,600,000, or 92.75% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,971,556 to $8,388,601, a 4.25x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 60 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 59 (-10).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Zendesk, Fin, Crisp.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
